text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука first showed her
extraordinary
runaway style to the world
at her debut race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But, paying no mind to the popularity
she's
gained since then, she trains today
looking as
calm as ever.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Phew... I've finished cooling down.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: That should do it for today then.

text_block_list.text: Understood.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: You're looking good, Suzuka.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Oh! Эйр Грув. Are you training right
now too?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
It's Эйр Грув, the "Empress." She's the
very
paradigm of a proud and dignified
racer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm training. But more importantly...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I watched your debut the other day. It
was quite
the display.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
You looked completely at ease on the
track. I
don't think I've ever seen you run
like that. It was
almost a little scary.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
At the same time, I think running
unrestrained like
that suits you best.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I've realized that I don't have
to think
so much when I'm running.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I just need to keep running forward...
until I've
reached the place where I want
to go.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Heh. You're a special one, aren't you?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
However, you should know, the Twinkle
Series
isn't quite that simple. You've got
a difficult road
ahead.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Every single one of your opponents will
do
anything that it takes to win. Don't
forget that.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Her success depends on your
efforts as
well. I hope you won't waste
her talents.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Not a bad response. Well then,
I'll take my
leave.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: See you later, Эйр Грув.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
She's right. It's up to me to lead Silence
Suzuka to
success in the Twinkle Series.
I'll make sure that
happens!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
That night, inside the noisy dorm
cafeteria,
Сайленс Судзука quietly eats
alone.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...This looks tasty.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Hey, look. It's Сайленс Судзука. I heard
she's a
really good racer.
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
She's kinda aloof though. I get nervous
trying to
strike up a conversation with
her...
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text: Oh! Suzuka!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Oh, Spe. What's up?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: I've got some big news for you!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
With Спешл Уик's arrival, the party of
one
quickly becomes a party of fun.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So, today I was walking through the
shopping
district, and guess what I saw
playing on a TV? It
was your debut race!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
You're always amazing, of course, but
during an
actual race, you just...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Sparkle! Seriously, I was completely
floored!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука begins to laugh. She's a
sight
different from moments before,
when she was
eating quietly by herself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hehe. Oh, Spe...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
You're gonna be on TV a lot more, now
that
you've started the Twinkle Series,
right? I can't
wait!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Oh! That reminds me! I bought these
strawberry
mochi while I was there in the
shopping district! ♪
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Wanna eat 'em together later?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Sounds good. Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Huh? D-did I say something funny?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, no, no. You're just always so full
of energy,
Spe.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Oh! I'm sorry!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I like that about you. Can we have the
strawberry
mochi once I finish eating?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Of course!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
They continue chatting together for a
time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Спешл Уик is kind of amazing...
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Right? It's like she's got both great and
terrible
communication skills at the same
time...
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text:
Little do they know how much attention
is
currently focused on them.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
